fields.Licence note: same open question as the m02 scan (Q55), not re-decided. The FHIR licence page (https://hl7.org/fhir/R4/license.html, 2026-11-27) says "This document is licensed under Creative Commons 'No Rights Reserved'", "You can redistribute FHIR", and does not grant rights over third-party terminologies; that page covers the specification text, and the repository's own LICENSE says the source has several licences (m02 scan), so the verdict is left to Q55. Read facts: MedicationStatement is Maturity Level 3, "Trial Use", records what is actually taken (including non-prescription use), `medication[x]` and `status` are required, `effective[x]`, `dosage`, `reasonCode`, `basedOn` optional. MedicationRequest is Maturity Level 3 and is an order (`intent` required), its scope names diet and vitamin supplements. PlanDefinition is Maturity Level 2, "Trial Use", a "pre-defined group of actions", with `version`, `status` (draft, active, retired, unknown), `action`, `goal`, `relatedAction`, `timing[x]`. CarePlan is Maturity Level 2, with `status`, `intent`, `activity`, `period`, `instantiatesCanonical`. Assessment: MedicationStatement fits "what a user takes" and PlanDefinition fits a protocol template (with `version`), CarePlan a user's running instance; each is an export mapping target, not a storage schema. Each page was read only in part (the first 100,000 characters of the text; the rest was not read).
